# Button

Generated from the spec. This page is a reference to the contract, not usage guidance.

Runs an action. One primary button per view; everything else is secondary, neutral or ghost.

Stage: **alpha**. Figma: `Button` (mapping not yet confirmed against the Components file). Behaviour: `@radix-ui/react-slot`.

## Keyboard

Pattern: [WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices: Button](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/). Name: The label. With iconOnly, the ariaLabel prop.

| Key | Part | Does | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Enter | root | Runs the action. | `button-enter-activates` |
| Space | root | Runs the action. | `button-space-activates` |
| Tab | root | Moves focus to and from the button, including while loading. | `button-loading-stays-focusable` |

## Requirements

Grouped MUST, then SHOULD, then COULD. A check starting manual: is not proven by a machine.

| Level | Id | Requirement | Checked by | WCAG |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MUST | `button-native-element` | The root is a button element, or with asChild a link. It is never a div or a span. | `test:button-native-element` | 4.1.2 |
| MUST | `button-type-default` | The type attribute is button unless the type prop says otherwise. | `test:button-type-default` |  |
| MUST | `button-name` | The button has an accessible name. | `axe:button-name` | 4.1.2 |
| MUST | `button-icon-only-needs-label` | With iconOnly, ariaLabel is required: the type of the props says so, and the component warns in development when it is missing. | `type:button-icon-only-needs-label` | 4.1.2 |
| MUST | `button-icons-hidden` | iconStart, iconEnd and the spinner carry aria-hidden. | `test:button-icons-hidden` | 1.1.1 |
| MUST | `button-enter-activates` | Enter calls onClick once. | `test:button-enter-activates` | 2.1.1 |
| MUST | `button-space-activates` | Space calls onClick once. | `test:button-space-activates` | 2.1.1 |
| MUST | `button-disabled-inert` | While disabled, a press does not call onClick. | `test:button-disabled-inert` |  |
| MUST | `button-loading-inert` | While loading, a press does not call onClick. | `test:button-loading-inert` |  |
| MUST | `button-loading-stays-focusable` | While loading, the button keeps keyboard focus and stays in the Tab order, with aria-busy and aria-disabled set to true and the native disabled attribute absent. | `test:button-loading-stays-focusable` | 2.4.3 |
| MUST | `button-focus-visible` | With keyboard focus the root shows a ring at least 2 pixels thick with at least 3 to 1 contrast against what is beside it. | `test:button-focus-visible` | 2.4.7 |
| MUST | `button-label-contrast` | In every variant and state except disabled, the label has at least 4.5 to 1 contrast against the fill, in light and dark. | `test:button-label-contrast` | 1.4.3 |
| MUST | `button-target-size` | The root is at least 24 by 24 pixels at every size. | `test:button-target-size` | 2.5.8 |
| MUST | `button-label-wraps` | A label too long for one line wraps inside the button and keeps its padding; it is never cut off. | `test:button-label-wraps` | 1.4.10 |
| SHOULD | `button-touch-target` | Where the pointer is coarse the root is at least 44 pixels tall. (pattern) | `test:button-touch-target` |  |
| SHOULD | `button-one-primary` | A view has at most one primary button. (pattern) | `lint:one-primary-per-view` |  |
| SHOULD | `button-error-not-colour-alone` | A danger button states the destructive action in its label, such as Delete project, because in the dark theme its fill is close in colour to the primary fill. (pattern) | `manual:button-error-not-colour-alone` | 1.4.1 |
| COULD | `button-loading-label` | While loading, the label says what is happening, such as Saving, and keeps any amount. (assumption) | `manual:button-loading-label` |  |

## Content rules

- Start with a verb and name the result: Save changes, not OK.
- Sentence case. No full stop.
- An ellipsis only while loading.

## What the spec does not carry

- The live Figma component: its properties were read from a cached copy inside the Semantic Tokens file, which is older than the published library, so every figma mapping here is unconfirmed. That copy has variant values primary, secondary, tertiary, outline, ghost, danger, dangerSoft; state values default, hover, focus, disabled; sizes sm, md, lg.
- Motion beyond a colour transition.
- Button groups and split buttons.
- A toggle (pressed) button: that is a different role and a different component.
- The send button's hover and shadow fixes listed in the UI fixes tracker.
- The word for a destructive action differs: the Figma variant is danger and the token is interactive/error. The spec follows Figma for the prop and the token file for the token; one of the two should be renamed.
